sq-mixkit-52106-front.how: Bottoms read from a 2 fps contact sheet. Goblet squats, thighs about level, knees over the feet: good form.

sq-mixkit-52117-45.how: 4 fps sheet. Two good squats; from 5.4 s the person steps back into a lunge, which is not a squat and should not be counted.

sq-mixkit-52116-front-low.how: 4 fps sheet. One full squat; a second one begins as the clip ends. Camera low, looking up.

sq-mixkit-752-45.how: 2 fps sheet. Wall-ball squats with the ball overhead at the top; the camera is about 45 degrees off the front, not from the side. The clip opens at the bottom of a squat: the coach waits for the start position, so that half repetition is not labelled.

sq-cdc-half-45.how: 1 fps sheet and the source's own title: a deliberate HALF squat (thighs well above level), so for a full squat the depth is wrong on purpose. Real wrong-depth evidence. The third squat of the first shot and the one of the second shot are cut before they end.

sq-tf-goblet-front.how: 1.7 fps sheet. Kettlebell goblet squats on a beach, facing the camera, bright sun. Two full squats with long pauses standing: good form.

sq-tf-frontraise-side.how: 2 fps sheet. Kettlebell squats with a front raise at the bottom, from the side, deep: good form. At 9.5-10.5 s he bends forward to swing the kettlebell (a hinge, not a squat): it must not be counted.

pu-mixkit-50762-side.how: 2 fps sheet. Four push-ups filmed about 50 degrees off the side (closer to the front): outside the push-up's camera setup, so the guide asks to turn and nothing is counted, on purpose.

pu-cdc-knee-45.how: 2.5 fps sheet. Knee push-ups, camera about 20-35 degrees off the side. The hips look slightly bent; by eye we cannot say whether that is a fault, so the body-line rule is not judged on this clip (neither a false alarm nor a catch).

pu-cdc-full-45.how: 2.5 fps sheet. The clip ends at the bottom of its only push-up: nothing complete to count.

pu-interval-side.how: 2.5 fps sheet. Slow push-ups with a hold at the bottom, backlit silhouette from the side; straight body line: good form.

pu-mixkit-731-front.how: Push-ups filmed from the front at floor level: the body line cannot be seen, the guide asks to turn, nothing is counted, on purpose.

pu-mixkit-50761-front.how: Same as 731: push-ups from the front.

pu-tf-crush-side.how: 6 fps zoomed sheet. Fast close-grip push-ups with the hands on a kettlebell, from the side: chest down to the kettlebell, straight body line. Good form (the fast descent is a tempo tip, not a fault).

sp-mixkit-42899-front.how: 3 fps sheet. Light dumbbells, standing, camera low and looking up. Two full presses from the shoulders to lockout and back; a third reaches the top as the clip ends.

sp-cdc-seated-wide.how: 1 fps sheet. Seated; one press at the end of the shot, cut before it comes down: nothing complete to count.

sp-cdc-seated-close.how: 3 fps sheet. Seated, head to chest in the picture (hips not seen). The shot opens at the top; two full presses rack-top-rack follow; the last one is cut at the top. Good form.

sp-army-pushpress-front.how: 1 and 3 fps sheets. Kettlebell push press (a small knee dip), standing, whole body. The first two shots hold the rack or the top; one complete press in the third shot.

sp-colossus-45-close.how: 3 fps sheet. Seated, camera about 45 degrees, head to chest. Three full presses: good form.

sp-colossus-partial-45.how: 3 fps sheet. The source's 'common mistake' part (a red cross on screen): partial presses that come down only to about ear level and do not lock out. The source does not say which fault it shows; every repetition the coach counts must be judged not clean, and the coach must say to lower to the shoulders. Real wrong-form evidence.
